newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Suharto has full schedule on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Suharto has full schedule on Thursday.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto was scheduled to meet senior government officials on Thursday at his presidential office, palace sources said.
"The President has a full schedule today and he's fine. He's going to meet senior government officials," the source told Reuters by telephone.
The source denied rumours that Suharto was not well.
Suharto will meet Industry and Trade Minister Tunky Ariwibowo and Foreign Minister Ali Alatas at his office in central Jakarta, the source said.
